items.html:
Brandon Bess, a tall fast bowler from Guyana, was among the players selected for training at the High Performance Centre in Barbados. He received a shock call-up for the third Test against South Africa at the Kensington Oval, after Nelon Pascal picked up a neck injury in the warm-up session prior to the game.
Cricinfo Staff, June 2010
